content:
Priya (CS): quick note — putting together a one-page runbook for low-touch customers who expect bursty usage. wanted a sanity check before i ship it to AE handoffs.
Lydia (AE): love it. can it be 1 pager + a TL;DR checklist? AE's like two bullets. :pray:
Priya (CS): yep doing TL;DR + 3 progressive steps: preflight, live-safety, recovery. also adding recommended client-side configs for fallback.
Priya (CS): preflight section draft: 1) confirm API key & region 2) sample qps & typical prompt size 3) enable short retention telemetry for first 72h 4) opt into burst pool (if available)
Dan (SRE): add: set client retry jitter to 300-1200ms and circuit-breaker at 5xx-rate > 10% over 1m. keeps us from cascading.
Priya (CS): good call. i'll add that under "live-safety" as well.
Sameer (PM): for batching guidance — can we give a simple rule: if median prompt tokens < 300, enable 100ms batching window on the client; otherwise 30ms. keeps latency predictable.
Priya (CS): adding. also adding an explicit note about prefix caching: encourage callers to dedupe repeated system prompts or shared context on the client and send as explicit "context_id" header for server-side KV reuse.
Lydia (AE): can we give a tiny example snippet for context_id header? AE teams want copy-paste.
Priya (CS): sure — small snippet for fetch: ```js
fetch('/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $KEY', 'X-Context-Id': 'tenant-123:welcome' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt })
})
```
OnboardBot: reminder — attach "sample telemetry dashboard" link to runbook before publishing.
Priya (CS): done. under monitoring: 1) watch 95th p95 latency 2) token cost per 1k requests 3) error-rate by route 4) customer-configured prefill hit rate.
Dan (SRE): add actionable alerts: p95 > 1.5s for 5m => page eng-oncall; error-rate > 5% for 10m => create triage ticket; prefill hit rate < 10% for 30m => ping AE for warmup.
Priya (CS): great. now recovery/playbook: three-step quick triage: A) switch routing to smaller model variant B) increase batching window + enable burst capacity C) temporary rate-limits on non-critical routes.
Sameer (PM): also include a short note on renewal risk signals: sustained >20% error-rate or repeated cost surprises on invoice. triggers a high-touch outreach.
Lydia (AE): add a checkbox: "Confirm billing alert thresholds set" for AE before go-live.
Priya (CS): added. final section: short troubleshooting table (one-line entries):
- symptom: sudden latency spike -> check region routing, prefill hit rate, p95, model variant
- symptom: cost spike -> check token distribution, long prompts, accidental loops
- symptom: frequent 429s -> increase client concurrency limits or enable client-side backoff
Priya (CS): any objections to publishing as a CS + AE co-branded runbook?
Lydia (AE): no objections. maybe call it "Low-touch go-live checklist — bursty apps" (AE will rename in portal).
OnboardBot: publish reminder scheduled in 2h.
Priya (CS): perfect. i'll publish and link to onboarding playbook. thanks all :rocket:
